body:
Source: GitHub issue #899 (same defect class as #786/#879, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ 6ddd5992: `plugins/adlc-opencode/bin/cli.mjs` (around line 69) dispatches with `if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) { process.exit(cliMain()); }`. `package.json` declares `"bin": { "adlc-opencode": "bin/cli.mjs" }`, so the normal install path is `npm i -g @adlc/opencode-plugin`-style, which bin-links `node_modules/.bin/adlc-opencode` as a SYMLINK to this file. Invoked through that symlink, `argv[1]` is the link path while `import.meta.url` resolves to the real target file — the comparison is false, `cliMain()` never runs, and the process exits 0 having silently done nothing. This is the exact shape #786 fixed for `fleet` and `ticket-sync`, and PR #879 hardened further with regression tests; this plugin was reviewed alongside #879 but deliberately excluded to keep that PR to its declared scope.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `plugins/adlc-opencode`: bin/cli.mjs (the whole CLI entry — read the full file, not just the guard, to find `cliMain()` and understand the surrounding structure), lib/*.mjs (deployment/registration logic `cliMain()` calls into). The CORRECT, already-shipped reference pattern is `entryUrl()` in `packages/fleet/bin/fleet.mjs` (around line 289) and mirrored in `packages/ticket-sync/bin/ticket-sync.mjs`: `function entryUrl() { if (!process.argv[1]) return null; try { return pathToFileURL(realpathSync(process.argv[1])).href; } catch { return null; } }` then `if (entryUrl() === import.meta.url) runCli();` — realpath resolves the symlink to its real target BEFORE building the `file://` URL, so the comparison matches regardless of whether the invocation went through a symlink. Mirror this exact function and comparison shape; do not invent a different fix. Tests: root runner segment for this plugin (`grep -n "adlc-opencode" scripts/run-tests.mjs` for the exact name/argv).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Add an `entryUrl()` function to `bin/cli.mjs`, identical in shape to fleet's (import `realpathSync` from `node:fs` if not already imported): returns the realpath'd `file://` href of `argv[1]`, or `null` when there is no resolvable entry (no `argv[1]`, or a nonexistent path that `realpathSync` cannot resolve — catch and return null, never throw).
2. Replace the existing guard's condition with `if (entryUrl() === import.meta.url) { process.exit(cliMain()); }` (keep the existing `process.exit(cliMain())` call shape — only the guard condition changes).
3. Import the module (not invoke as a script) must still be side-effect-free — the guard function itself must not run `cliMain()` or touch `process.argv` parsing beyond what it already needs; a unit test importing this module for its other exports (if any) must not trigger a live dispatch.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (mirror PR #879's three regression cases for this plugin).
- AC1 A symlinked invocation (create a real file + a symlink to it in a temp dir, invoke `node <symlink> --help` or similar) DISPATCHES `cliMain()` — the exact false-green this issue describes. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/entry-guard.test.mjs`
- AC2 A no-argument invocation (`argv[1]` absent, e.g. `node -e "import('./bin/cli.mjs')"`) does NOT dispatch and does NOT crash — `entryUrl()` returns `null`, the comparison is false, importing the module is side-effect-free. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/entry-guard.test.mjs`
- AC3 A nonexistent `argv[1]` path does not crash `entryUrl()` (the `realpathSync` throw is caught, returns `null`). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/entry-guard.test.mjs`
- AC4 Regression: a DIRECT (non-symlinked) invocation still dispatches exactly as before. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/entry-guard.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green (confirm actual baseline count). verify: `npm test -w plugins/adlc-opencode` or the package's test command
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: any change to `cliMain()`'s own behaviour, or to any other plugin's entry guard.

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/entry-guard.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to plugins/adlc-opencode/bin/cli.mjs, the new test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(adlc-opencode): ...`, body must contain `Closes #899`.
title: plugin(adlc-opencode): realpath argv[1] in the CLI entry guard so a symlinked install actually dispatches
